description.default: The full URL of the SharePoint site that hosts the PPMF Error Events list. Required when Writing Mode is SharePoint or Both. Example: https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/PPMF. Do not include a trailing slash. The account used by the PPMF SharePoint connection reference must have Contribute access to this site.
